title: WhatsApp MCP server (lharries/whatsapp-mcp)
summary: A community MCP server for a personal WhatsApp account, identified by repository in the cited write-up. Its ordinary function covers all three legs of the pattern behind most of the registry: it returns messages strangers can send, reads the user's chat history, and sends messages.

evidence.note: Anyone who has the user's number can send a message, and it shows up in the result of the server's list_chats tool.
The server lets the agent check messages and retrieve chat history; the write-up describes the user's entire chat history being exfiltrated through it.
The server lets the agent send WhatsApp messages; in the write-up the recipient is redirected to an attacker-controlled number.
